title: What if you could see 10 seconds into the future?
hook: You can see ten seconds into the future.

scenes.text: You can see ten seconds into the future.
Not in a dream. A faint copy of the world plays out right in front of you, ten seconds ahead of everyone else.
A cup is about to fall. You catch it before it even tips.
Most people need a quarter of a second just to react. You get ten whole seconds.
Then one afternoon, the copy shows you a kid chasing a ball into the road. And a car that can't stop in time.
At city speed, a car needs over twenty meters to stop. This one has eight.
So you run, before anyone else knows there's a reason to.
You pull him back. The car flies past. And everyone just saw you grab a stranger's kid.
His mom screams at you. You can't explain. Nobody else saw what you saw.
That night, alone at the bus stop, it hits you. Ten seconds is enough to save someone. It's never enough to explain why.
Then the copy shows you one more thing. Footsteps. His mom, coming back, to say thank you.
If you could see it coming... would you still jump in?

visual.headline: would you still jump in?
visual.subhead: If you could see it coming...

cta: Would you still jump in? Tell me in the comments.
